note: Scripted by demo/make_transcripts.py from the reference packs; not produced by a language model. Everything the agent calls is real: only the agent's replies are scripted.

manifest.description: Play a hand of blackjack across calls with a seeded shuffle (same seed, same deal): new, hit, stand or show; the dealer draws to 17.
manifest.name: blackjack_session
manifest.when_to_use: The task is to play blackjack, test a strategy or replay a hand, and the hand must be remembered between calls.

turns.say: A game that lasts across calls needs a session tool. Write one and submit it.
Verified and promoted. Open a session: deal a new hand.
Step 1 is the deal. Hit once (step 2).
Change of mind: rewind to step 1, the state right after the deal.
The hand is over. Close the session: that ends the sandbox and audits it.
